name: KOReader
description: All 5 OTA mirrors are plain http (no TLS in the update stack); payload hash from the same unauthenticated manifest; re-execs into the downloaded .tar.xz. MITM/CDN of any host = RCE, often elevated on jailbroken e-readers. [Opus-verified: CONFIRMED-D]
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The retained OTA manager uses plaintext HTTP and compares the archive to a manifest-supplied digest; installation hands the update to the device restart path. The digest is not an independent signature or trust root.
limitations: Review is limited to the retained commit; it does not certify released artifacts or current upstream behavior.
